row.evidence: ScreenCloud's Entra SCIM guide says 'SSO and SCIM for ScreenCloud is only available on the Enterprise tier plan', and the pricing page lists Enterprise as Contact Sales.
row.notes: Unchanged gate (Enterprise, Contact Sales), but the seat minimum is now 35 screens (help centre), not the June 25; June's 25-screen figure had no first-party source found and is dropped. Priced per screen with unlimited users, so per-user price fields are now null (June recorded $20 as per-user). Core $20 and Pro $30 per screen/month billed annually. SSO help article says SSO is on Pro and Enterprise with a 35-license annual minimum, while the pricing grid shows SSO only on Enterprise. SCIM works through custom Okta and non-gallery Entra apps using a tenant SCIM URL and token; SSO must be set up first. Category: digital signage for internal communications (closest fit Collaboration & Messaging).

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Priced per screen with unlimited users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: SSO help article says SSO is available on Pro with a minimum of 35 licenses billed annually; the pricing grid shows SSO only on Enterprise (see conflicts).

scim.notes: Tenant-specific SCIM Tenant URL shown in Account > Organization > Single Sign-On > Provisioning Settings; URL pattern not published.

auth.token_source: Account > Organization > Single Sign-On > Provisioning Settings > Generate SCIM API token
auth.notes: Okta uses HTTP Header (Authorization) auth with the generated token; token is shown once and can be regenerated.

operations.notes: Okta article: creating, updating and deleting users and groups; To App options Create Users, Update User Attributes, Deactivate User; Push Groups supported. HTTP methods not documented.

deprovision.notes: Docs say removed users are provisioned by Entra on the next cycle but do not say whether ScreenCloud deactivates or deletes them.

group: groups carry across to ScreenCloud groups

roles.how: Group-based: a provisioned IdP group becomes a ScreenCloud group whose permissions are set in ScreenCloud; users without a group get no permissions.

limitations.text: SSO must be configured before SCIM.
Users provisioned without a group get no permissions until assigned in ScreenCloud.

user_api.notes: GraphQL API listed on every plan on the pricing page. The GraphQL schema docs (screencloud.github.io/signage-next-graphql-docs) are a JS app and were not read, so no operations are recorded.

capabilities.notes: From the help article's example 'creating/removing users in your ScreenCloud spaces'.

audit_log_api.notes: User audit logs are a Pro feature and enhanced audit logs Enterprise in the UI; no audit-log API found.

okta.notes: Custom SAML 2.0 app integration with SCIM enabled; no ScreenCloud page on okta.com/integrations (404).

entra.notes: Non-gallery enterprise application with automatic provisioning.

onelogin.notes: Named as an SSO IdP in ScreenCloud's SSO article; no SCIM guide.
